Message:
feat(Vine): Add action-button Items field to ShowMessageRequest

Extend the ShowMessageRequest protobuf message with a repeated `Items` string field to carry optional action-button labels alongside the message text. This allows Mountain-side callers (or Cocoon) to present a message with user-selectable actions, enabling confirmation dialogs, choice prompts, and interactive notifications over the gRPC channel.

The generated Rust code in `Source/Generated/vine.rs` is regenerated from the proto, adding the `items: Vec<String>` field to the `ShowMessageRequest` struct with the corresponding prost annotation and wire tag.

The field is optional (empty vector) by default, preserving backward compatibility with existing callers that only send a plain message.
